_comment: The curated window() facade of ADR 0022. Hand-edited; UpdateData vendors the specs listed here
from @webref/idl and trims BCD to these interfaces. Widen v1 by listing more.
facades: interfaces reached by path, with their members, or * for all that map.
statics: interface objects on window whose static members and constructor are exposed.
snapshots: interfaces that only arrive as results; their attributes are copied into a value class.
mixins: extra mixins whose members join a facade (ADR 0022 puts focus on Element).
exclude: members left out on purpose; argTypes: IDL object parameters given a dictionary type.
